purpose: zero-model retrospective handoff controls; never rescore v1 or supply answers to live model

checked.source:
$/name = ""
$/accept = false
name = TextField(label="Name", value=$/name)
accept = CheckBox(label="Accept", value=$/accept)
submit = Button(child=Text(text="Save form"), action=Event("save", {name: $/name, accept: $/accept}))
validation = FormValidation(buttons=["submit"], rules=[
  {fieldId:"name", message:"Name is required (2 to 5 characters)", required:true, minLength:2, maxLength:5},
  {fieldId:"accept", message:"You must accept to save", required:true}
])
root = Card(child=Column(children=[name, accept, validation, submit]))
